item.title: [+1] US Dollar Rallies as Fed Rate Risks Pressure Global Markets
item.description:
Signal: a stronger dollar. 10 reports from FXEmpire, BigGo Finance, TradingView and 6 more. Related: “US dollar hits 19-month high on Fed rate hike bets”. Ongoing: also reported on 2 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Dollar earnings worth more

Why it matters: A stronger dollar pressures the rupee and draws foreign money out of emerging markets.

Market gauges: Rupee −1, Foreign investor flows −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Rupee flies high in Asia on easing crude oil prices, foreign flows
item.description:
Signal: a stronger rupee. 6 reports from FXStreet, Devdiscourse, Free Press Journal and 2 more. Related: “Indian Rupee strengthens on lower oil prices, AI unwinding”. Turn: earlier readings (14 Nov) pointed the other way.

IT services: mild headwind (−1) — Exporters' rupee earnings shrink

Why it matters: A stronger rupee lowers import costs and inflation but trims IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee +3, Inflation outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
